claims: Artemis II is the first crewed mission to deep space in over 50 years.
Artemis II validates the Orion spacecraft life support systems with astronauts aboard.
Artemis II is a 10-day NASA mission.
The Artemis II crew will fly farther than any human before.
Artemis II is the first full-up test of NASA's deep-space navigation systems while human crew are aboard.
Artemis II is the first full-up test of NASA's deep-space propulsion systems while human crew are aboard.
Artemis II is the first full-up test of NASA's deep-space life support systems while human crew are aboard.
The Artemis II mission aims to break previous distance records for human travel from Earth.
Artemis II represents the first time humans have traveled toward the Moon since 1972.
Artemis II includes Jeremy Hansen, the first Canadian astronaut to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
The Artemis II crew includes Commander Reid Wiseman.
The Artemis II crew includes Pilot Victor Glover.
The Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Christina Koch.
The Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Jeremy Hansen
